status.en: 105 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 50% more than the week before, most of them in Tehran, Minab and Gulf Of Oman.

summary.en: Iran has installed a new defence minister and intensified IRGC drone and artillery strikes in Iraqi Kurdistan while launching missiles near the UAE and bombarding a tug in the Strait of Hormuz, expanding its maritime campaign. An explosion struck an Iranian-backed group in Iraq and Tehran urged the reopening of the strait. A powerful African military is considering joining Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Turkey to defend Saudi interests against Houthi attacks. The US ambassador to Israel condemned a settler attack on a US journalist in the West Bank. 123 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
